pr_comments:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/d9567eb106929b21329c01171fd398fbef2dc6c6/CHANGELOG.txt#L1256
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/62d490d4da17e35d4ddcd4ee38902a8a4e9bbfff/constraints-3.9.txt#L415

According to the change log and the constraints, the version is pinned at `3.12.3`.

> According to the change log and the constraints, the version is pinned at `3.12.3`.

* Changelog missed a change of unpinnnig.
* Constraints limit pymongo because currently apache-beam does - it's not Airflow that limits it.

The PR most likely needs to run full matrix of tests because it modifies parts of the core of Airflow. However, committers might decide to merge it quickly and take the risk. If they don't merge it quickly - please rebase it to the latest main at your convenience, or amend the last commit of the PR, and push it with --force-with-lease.

Thank you @ckljohn.

Not only is `ssl_cert_reqs` removed in that version, but pymongo 4.0 also drops support for MongoDB 2.6, 3.0, 3.2, and 3.4. Users of this provider (myself included) might be on one of those db versions and since pymongo was not pinned it would cause breaking changes for them production. I had to deploy a hotfix in my production env to pin it like shown here.
